sections.text: مقدمة

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1 required for vertical 
rotary regenerative air pre heater, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Gamal Elsyed 
Osily , reviewed by maintenance manager eng. Sobhey Abdel Haleem, approved by 
eng. Mohamed Abdel Ghaffar: general manager of Al-Arish power station.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector

sections.text:
Seal replacement and setting (fig 
5)
Fix aluminum finger tabs at in board and out board of a diaphragm

Move this diaphragm plate under the sealing surface and adjust the 
finger tab to the required seal clearance

Set the channel type straight edge (redial) at a convenient 
location

Move the finger tabs under the straight edge and set the straight 
edge to sit over the tabs firmly clamp the straight edge

Set one radial seal assembly butting the seal leaves with the 
straight edge. move the seal under the same edge of the sealing surface and 
confirm the correctness of the straight edge setting
Then proceed with the installation of the rest of the radial seals

Install outboard radial seal tabs as per radial seal assembly 
drawing excess metal is to be trimmed off to obtain clearance shown and required
